thesis: Public discovery is free. Paid API work is prepaid, metered, entitlement-gated, and hard-capped. Stripe records settlement; the existing commerce and economic-observation spine records fulfillment and proof.
economic_truth: API activity is not revenue. Revenue requires matched settled Stripe payment, entitlement, fulfillment, and evidence.

authentication.rule: Never place tokens in URLs, public logs, or client-side public source.
authentication.human_authority: Consequential external actions still require explicit human authorization.

toll_tiers.name: Discovery
includes: Public Agent Bridge manifest and health

toll_tiers.name: Bridge API Starter Pack
activation_requirements: Dedicated Stripe SKU and Checkout URL
Idempotent usage debit in the existing authoritative persistence layer
Live acceptance tests for payment, duplicate webhook, duplicate request, quota exhaustion, and fulfillment

toll_tiers.name: Proof Attestation
includes: Validation of a supplied evidence object against the published proof contract

related_existing_offers.name: Discord Webhook Starter Kit
related_existing_offers.relationship: Separate downloadable integration product; purchase does not grant Agent Bridge API quota.

exclude: Retries carrying the same idempotency key
metering_contract.charge_before_execution: Reserve one unit atomically before billable work begins; release only on a confirmed pre-execution failure.
metering_contract.duplicate_request: Same tenant, idempotency key, and request digest returns the original result and does not consume a second unit.
metering_contract.quota_exhausted: Return 402 or 429 with a machine-readable quota code and no side effect; do not silently overdraw.
metering_contract.authority: Do not create a parallel ledger. Use the existing commerce entitlement and authoritative economic-observation spine; if the required atomic quota operation is not available, fail closed rather than simulate it.

payment_to_fulfillment: Stripe Checkout for the dedicated bridge SKU
Verify signed webhook and settled payment server-side
Match the purchase to the canonical SKU and create/reconcile entitlement idempotently
Issue a revocable API token without exposing the secret again in public logs
Atomically reserve and meter each billable operation
Record fulfillment and evidence through the existing economic-observation contract
Reconcile Stripe settlement, entitlement, usage, and delivered result
scale_rule: Clone a paid route only after an independently verified external purchase and successful fulfillment.
explicit_non_claims: The API Starter Pack and Route Lease are proposed, not currently purchasable.
The existing $79 integration kit is not an API entitlement.
Published routes and contract tests do not prove successful live authenticated traffic or revenue.
